title: AutoQueue-McPvPClub
description: Automatic queue system for gamemodes on the server mcpvp.club
body:
# AutoQueue McPvP

Automatically queues you for PvP matches when you're in the lobby.

## Features

- **Auto-queue detection** - Detects when you have a "Create Party" nether star in your inventory
- **Multiple game modes** - Supports Sword, Axe, Mace, UHC, Nethop, Pot, SMP, and Vanilla modes
- **Debug mode** - Toggle debug output to troubleshoot detection issues

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/autoqueue` | Toggle autoqueue on/off |
| `/autoqueue start` | Enable autoqueue |
| `/autoqueue stop` | Disable autoqueue |
| `/autoqueue debug` | Toggle debug messages |
| `/autoqueue sword` | Set mode to Sword |
| `/autoqueue axe` | Set mode to Axe |
| `/autoqueue mace` | Set mode to Mace |
| `/autoqueue uhc` | Set mode to UHC |
| `/autoqueue nethop` | Set mode to Nethop |
| `/autoqueue pot` | Set mode to Pot |
| `/autoqueue smp` | Set mode to SMP |
| `/autoqueue vanilla` | Set mode to Vanilla |

## How It Works

When autoqueue is enabled, the mod checks your inventory every second for a nether star named "Create Party". When found, it automatically executes `/queue <selected_mode>` to queue you for your chosen game mode.

## Installation

1. Install [Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/)
2. Install [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
3. Download and place this mod in your `mods` folder

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

---

*Made for McPvP - never miss a queue again!*
